title: Systems pharmacology of phytochemical anacardic acid in the chemoprevention of hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Panda, Sangita; Subudhi, Enketeswara; Routray, Sweta Padma; Nair, Sujit
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和网络药理学研究漆树酸对肝细胞癌的化学预防作用，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但核心是药物靶点与疾病通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a common type of liver cancer that progresses quickly and has limited treatment options. Nutraceutical anacardic acid (AA), a bioactive compound derived from cashew nut shell, has emerged as a potential candidate for HCC treatment owing to its reported anti-inflammatory, anticancer and diverse pharmacological properties. In the present study, we investigate the potential of AA as an HCC inhibitor using molecular docking, gene ontology, and network pharmacology. METHODS: The pharmacokinetic and physicochemical properties of AA were assessed using Swiss ADME. SuperPred, Similarity Ensemble Approach, ChEMBL and Swiss Target Prediction online tools were used for determining molecular targets of AA. In addition, GeneCards, NCBI, DisGeNET and UniProt ID were used to search the targets of HCC and the top 25 hub genes were determined using Cytohubba plugin. A protein protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed through the STRING database. Gene Ontology (GO) biological process and Kyoto Encyclopaedia of Genes and Genes (KEGG) pathway enrichment analysis were performed through FunRich and ShinyGO 0.77. Moreover, molecular docking studies were performed on NF-kappaB and GSK-3beta. The expression levels of the hub genes were also validated by western blotting. RESULTS: Comprehensive data analysis identified 375 targets for AA and 11,333 for HCC, with 264 targets in common. Network analysis determined 25 key HCC targets, including caspase-3, and NF-kappaB. Gene ontology and topology analysis highlighted essential pathways implicated in HCC progression such as the renin-angiotensin system, VEGF signalling, and apoptosis. Molecular docking analysis revealed strong binding affinity of HCC proteins with NF-kappaB and GSK-3beta. Upregulation of p-NRF2 and p-GSK-3beta, and downregulation of p-NF-kappaB and caspase-1 expression were validated using western blotting. CONCLUSIONS: Taken together, our study highlights the potential of AA as a promising chemopreventive agent for HCC because of its significant modulatory effects on important regulatory proteins linked to cell division, inflammation, apoptosis, and antioxidant response.
abstract_zh: 目的：肝细胞癌（HCC）是一种常见的肝癌类型，进展迅速且治疗选择有限。营养保健品腰果壳酸（AA），一种源自腰果壳的生物活性化合物，因其报道的抗炎、抗癌及多种药理特性，已成为HCC治疗的潜在候选药物。在本研究中，我们利用分子对接、基因本体论和网络药理学探讨AA作为HCC抑制剂的潜力。方法：使用Swiss ADME评估AA的药代动力学和理化性质。利用SuperPred、Similarity Ensemble Approach、ChEMBL和Swiss Target Prediction在线工具确定AA的分子靶点。此外，使用GeneCards、NCBI、DisGeNET和UniProt ID搜索HCC的靶点，并通过Cytohubba插件确定前25个枢纽基因。通过STRING数据库构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。通过FunRich和ShinyGO 0.77进行基因本体论（GO）生物学过程及京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集分析。此外，对NF-kappaB和GSK-3beta进行了分子对接研究。枢纽基因的表达水平也通过western blotting验证。结果：综合分析数据确定了AA的375个靶点和HCC的11,333个靶点，其中264个靶点重叠。网络分析确定了25个关键HCC靶点，包括caspase-3和NF-kappaB。基因本体论和拓扑分析强调了与HCC进展相关的重要通路，如肾素-血管紧张素系统、VEGF信号传导和凋亡。分子对接分析显示HCC蛋白与NF-kappaB和GSK-3beta具有强结合亲和力。通过western blotting验证了p-NRF2和p-GSK-3beta的上调，以及p-NF-kappaB和caspase-1表达的下调。结论：综合来看，我们的研究强调了AA作为HCC有前景的化学预防剂的潜力，因为它对与细胞分裂、炎症、凋亡和抗氧化反应相关的重要调节蛋白具有显著调节作用。
